messages:
Alex: quick RFC follow-up on the latency-corridor idea — want to align on fairness heuristics for the continuous-batching scheduler. TL;DR: corridor = [p50, p95] band per-tenant; prefer packing when inside, throttle/segregate when outside.
Priya: +1. main worry is tenants with spiky tails that can game the corridor by sending short bursts. do we want per-tenant EWMA, short-window percentiles, or both?
Sam: prototyped EWMA + a lightweight spike detector. EWMA smooths but lags; spike detector flags a tenant as "bursty" for 1s and temporarily lowers pack probability. heuristic I used:
```
bursty = reqs_in_100ms > 10 || tail_latency_ms > 500
pack_prob = base_prob * (1 - soft_factor * bursty)
```
works on our microbench (single host) but needs global-scheduler semantics.
Jorge: ran a multi-tenant sim (100 tenants, mix small/large). baseline vs corridor+soft-bypass: p95 for small tenants improved ~12%, large-tenant gross throughput dropped ~4% (still within SLA). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/perf/5678 (heatmap + per-tenant timelines).
Priya: instead of hard bypass, propose "soft-cooldown": when bursty, multiply pack_probability by 0.3 for 200ms. reduces tail for co-tenants while keeping aggregate utilization.
Alex: sketching operator surface we need to expose. proposal (config keys we can ship as defaults):
{
  "corridor_percentiles": "[50,95]",
  "pack_threshold": "0.7",
  "burst_detection_window_ms": "100",
  "burst_cooldown_ms": "200",
  "soft_pack_factor": "0.3"
}
Note: runtime should validate ranges and have sane min/max.
Sam: +1. one caveat: admission layer uses credits/tokens; probabilistic pack_prob needs a deterministic mapping to credits to make admission accountable. I'll sketch a helper util `prob_to_credits(prob, slot_size)` and a PR.
Priya: I'll run a canary with soft-cooldown + EWMA on infra and post results by EOD. @infra-bot can you spin a 2-GPU cluster (A10) with 8 tenants and the canary config? :pray:
infra-bot: deploy started -> cluster/exp-lc-2024 (2xA10). logs: https://ci.redwood/build/888. status: starting nodes.
Alex: good. action items:
- Priya: run canary and share p50/p95 heatmaps + per-tenant pack_prob timelines.
- Sam: PR for prob->credits helper + unit tests.
- Jorge: add dashboard panels for `pack_prob`, `burstiness_score`, and `effective_credits_reserved`.
We'll reconvene Fri to finalize defaults and pick canary thresholds. Thanks all :thumbsup:
